name: Sharptalon's Claw

narrative.details: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.  Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
narrative.objectives: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Most impressive, adventurer... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes, mighty Champion, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
